description: Return true if all characters of the string s are identical and false otherwise. The empty string and every single-character string count as having all characters identical. When the result is false, s is non-empty and not every character of s equals its first character.
notes: VERINA's 'false' case says the string is non-empty and some character differs from the first one (an existential). Both specs state it as 'the first character occurs fewer than |s| times' (multiset count in Dafny, str.count in Python), which is equivalent and lets Dafny decide the concrete probes without an index witness.
